text:
Samir Patel: Heads up — Equinox returned the RFI. They want a compact compliance scorecard + a POC runbook and a 3-month cost estimate. Need by EOD tomorrow. Also asked for SLA/RTO specifics for Dedicated and fallback behavior.

Maria Chen: I can put together the one-page scorecard. For Private vs Hosted: do we include SOC2 attestation for Hosted and a note about customer responsibilities for Private? Also they explicitly called out KMS/HSM wording.

Jake O'Neill: For Dedicated: contract tier we're discussing has a 99.95% uptime SLA. Failover RTOs: regional fallback ~5m, cross-region warmup ~20-30m (model-size dependent). Adding runbook snippet now.

Jake O'Neill: Runbook snippet:
```
- Normal: route -> Dedicated pool (pinned)
- High load: degrade to smaller quantized variant + autoscale if capacity allows
- Dedicated outage (node-level): shift traffic to remaining pool; if pool exhausted -> fallback to Hosted compatible variant
- Cross-region failover: promote warm standby, KV cache cold -> rehydrate (estimate 20-30m for >30B models)
```

Nina Park: Security: we can state SOC2 Type II for Hosted. Private: customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault) and BYOK/HSM connector support. If they need an on-prem HSM appliance, that is a customer-side install and we can document connector steps.

Samir Patel: Add a line on EU data residency. Equinox wants reassurance about region pins and log isolation.

Maria Chen: Draft line: "Region pinning available for Hosted and Dedicated; in Private deployments metrics/logs can be routed to customer-owned sinks; no customer content is exported outside pinned regions unless explicitly configured by the customer."

Beth Alvarez: POC pricing (rough):
- Assumptions: 150k tokens/day avg, 2x Dedicated GPUs business hours, burst to shared evenings
- Reserved Dedicated: $68,000 / month
- Usage/overage & infra: ~$4,000 / month
- Optional on-prem integration engineering retainer: one-time $25,000
- Security assessment (optional): $8,000 (one-time)
Total estimated: $216,000 for 3 months + optional fees.

Samir Patel: Equinox wants a per-month breakdown and a line item for the security assessment. Can you put that in a simple spreadsheet and upload? Also include the optional integration retainer as a separate line.

Beth Alvarez: Uploaded: equinox_poc_breakdown_v2.xlsx

deploy-bot: File uploaded: equinox_poc_breakdown_v2.xlsx

Maria Chen: I will assemble the one-page scorecard (SOC2/ISO/KMS/HSM/data residency/encryption/access logs) and attach the runbook + cost xlsx and the security artifacts.

Nina Park: I'll attach the redacted pentest summary and the SOC2 cert. Filenames: redwood_soc2_type2.pdf, pentest_summary_redacted.pdf. Also attaching our SLA excerpt.

Samir Patel: Known blocker to call out in the runbook: warm-standby rehydrate time spikes for models >30B. Mark as "sales expectation" item.

Jake O'Neill: Noted and added to the runbook draft. If Equinox asks for faster cross-region failover we can propose pre-warming options (adds to cost).

Maria Chen: Action items: (1) I'll draft the scorecard + bundle; (2) Jake expands the runbook with exact timing notes; (3) Nina provides certs/pentest; (4) Beth finalizes spreadsheet with monthly and line-item breakout. Samir will review and we'll send the package tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Thanks team. I'll prepare a short cover note to include with the RFI package. Ping me if anything delays.

Beth Alvarez: Quick question — should the POC cost assume reserved billing or a mix of reserved + on-demand? Reserved gives a cleaner committed rate.

Samir Patel: Use reserved for the baseline POC, but note optional burst to shared on-demand at nights in the spreadsheet as an explicit assumption.

Maria Chen: Will do. Uploading draft scorecard and runbook in 2 hours.

Jake O'Neill: Flag: if they want full HSM appliance support, ops will need an access window and coordination — that should be in the integration retainer scope.

Samir Patel: Good call. Include that scope note in the cost spreadsheet and runbook.

Maria Chen: Drafts up in drive: /redwood/sales/equinox/rfi_drafts/ (will share links in the package).

Samir Patel: Great. Closing thread for now. We'll reconvene after internal review.
